# Oncology EMR Demo - React Project

## Project Overview
This is a React-based demonstration of an Oncology Electronic Medical Records (EMR) system with a modern, modular UI.

## Tech Stack
- React 18
- TypeScript
- Vite (build tool)
- Material-UI (UI components)
- React Router (navigation)

## Project Structure
- `/src/components` - Reusable UI components
- `/src/pages` - Page-level components
- `/src/data` - Mock/dummy data
- `/src/types` - TypeScript type definitions

## Development Guidelines
- Keep components modular and reusable
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Follow Material-UI design patterns
- Organize code by feature/functionality
